latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — create and export AI-generated videos from images, clips, and music for free.

- Upload up to five product photos and a background music file to generate a 1080p MP4 video in about 30–60 seconds.
- No paid software or timeline editing needed; just describe your desired outcome.
- Free anonymous session with 100 credits and cloud GPU rendering pipeline.
- Simple commands: upload files, request video creation, export, or check credits/status.
- Supports common formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, jpg, png, gif, mp3, wav, and more.
